requestedStyle: 16-bit pixel art matching the existing paper tiles

prompts.left:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: left interior page texture for a retro pixel-art food-collection passport.
Input image 1 is the page to restyle. Input image 2 is the paper tile atlas, a STYLE reference only. Deliver ONE portrait left passport page, not an atlas or mockup.
Primary request: redraw the page in chunky 16-bit console pixel art matching the paper tiles. Replace all fine engraving, realistic grain and tiny detail with bold visible square pixels, simple stepped shapes and large quiet areas of light ivory. Think a hand-made 128 by 192 logical pixel image enlarged eightfold using nearest-neighbor to 1024 by 1536. Every edge and detail is aligned to that same coarse square grid.
Preserve page layout: straight-on full-page portrait at 2:3 aspect ratio; binding only at the RIGHT edge, a narrow dark forest-green cover sliver around the LEFT outer edge and top/bottom, square stepped outer corners. Fill the full canvas edge to edge.
Paper palette: flat warm ivory #fbf6e6 and #f4ecd5 dominate; sparse pale beige #e7d8b3 square flecks; tan #d3bd91 and muted brown #b19466 at edges. Forest green at cover edge only. Passport watermark can use very pale sage, close in brightness to the cream.
Keep the faint passport identity but radically simplify it: one large very pale blocky globe watermark centered on the page and a narrow stepped pixel border with simple diamond corner ornaments. Convert detailed curves into sparse stair-step paths. Keep the interior extremely quiet and at least 85% blank light paper for future dish stickers.
The important visual is clearly visible large square pixels like the tile reference, NOT a realistic page with a pixel mosaic filter. Use only flat colors, crisp square clusters, sparse texture, restrained contrast. No smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealism, paper fibers, fine guilloche, tiny noise, text, letters, numbers, labels, stamps, dishes, stickers or extra objects. This is one empty usable page background.
